description: This file defines the RuntimeMessagingTrace class which inherits from MessagingTrace, providing detailed logging for various messaging events within the Orleans runtime, such as dispatcher errors, message forwarding, and message rejection.

classes.name: RuntimeMessagingTrace
classes.description: A sealed class responsible for tracing and logging various messaging-related events in Orleans runtime, including dispatch errors, message rejection, forwarding, and deadlock detection.

methods.name: OnDispatcherReceiveInvalidActivation
methods.description: Logs an invalid activation message processing event.

methods.name: OnDispatcherDiscardedRejection
methods.description: Logs when a message rejection is discarded with reason and exception details.

methods.name: OnDispatcherRejectMessage
methods.description: Logs when a message is rejected, including rejection type and reason.

methods.name: OnDispatcherForwarding
methods.description: Logs when a message forwarding attempt occurs, including attempt details.

methods.name: OnDispatcherForwardingFailed
methods.description: Logs when forwarding a message fails.

methods.name: OnDispatcherSelectTargetFailed
methods.description: Logs failure to select a target for message dispatching.
